answer: Stop sybils with quartz, a signal, and a meadow. Each identity must hold one quartz receipt: a custody chain whose serial hashes the last public signal pulse, so one pulse can validate only one face and no receipt can be copied to a second. A meadow holds one patch per funder: the k-th identity grazing the same patch posts k squared in bond, so a farm of N copies owes on the order of N cubed for one patch. If any identity on a patch cheats, the whole patch is fallowed and every bond on it burns together. A lone agent risks a single bond; a clone farm pays cubic tolls to share one field.
